rationale: The message reports observed flag behavior and formatting outcomes, not a request or decision. It also clarifies prior ambiguity about specific flags and invalid-flag handling.

evidence.text: Flag semantics: -e alone valid default YAML->JSON; -ie pretty+HTML escape; -n harmless.
Invalid -k on non-YAML output prints usage then Error flag -k only valid for YAML output; invalid chars list spaces (e.g. -abc => a b, c selects HCL so no c invalid).
